import csv, collections

region_rev = collections.defaultdict(float)
product_rev = collections.defaultdict(float)

with open("sample-orders.csv") as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        row = next(csv.DictReader([line], fieldnames=["order_id","date","region","product","qty","unit_price"]))
        if row["order_id"] == "order_id":   # skip header
            continue
        rev = float(row["qty"]) * float(row["unit_price"])
        region_rev[row["region"]] += rev
        product_rev[row["product"]] += rev

grand_total = sum(region_rev.values())
top_product, top_rev = max(product_rev.items(), key=lambda x: x[1])

# Print for verification
for r in sorted(region_rev):
    print(f"  {r}: {region_rev[r]:.2f}")
print(f"  Grand total: {grand_total:.2f}")
print(f"  Top product: {top_product} ({top_rev:.2f})")
print()
for p in sorted(product_rev):
    print(f"    {p}: {product_rev[p]:.2f}")

# Write report.md
lines = [
    "# Sales Revenue Report",
    "",
    "> **Data:** `sample-orders.csv` — fictional demo orders, 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-18  ",
    "> **Note:** Lines starting with `#` are comments and were excluded from calculations.",
    "",
    "## Revenue by Region",
    "",
    "| Region | Revenue (USD) |",
    "|--------|--------------|",
]

    lines.append(f"| {r} | ${region_rev[r]:,.2f} |")
lines += [
    f"| **Grand Total** | **${grand_total:,.2f}** |",
    "",
    "## Top Product by Revenue",
    "",
    f"**{top_product}** — ${top_rev:,.2f} total revenue across all regions.",
    "",
    "## Product Revenue Breakdown",
    "",
    "| Product | Revenue (USD) |",
    "|---------|--------------|",
]
for p in sorted(product_rev):
    lines.append(f"| {p} | ${product_rev[p]:,.2f} |")
lines += [""]

with open("report.md", "w") as f:
    f.write("\n".join(lines))

print("\nreport.md written successfully.")
